name: Conestoga College
overview:
Conestoga is a leader in polytechnic education and one of Ontario's fastest growing colleges, delivering a full range of career-focused education, training and applied research programs. Labs equipped with the latest technology, project-based courses, field and clinical experiences, international exchange, applied research and co-op opportunities engage our students as they learn to connect theory, research and practice. Their focus on technology-enhanced learning through online and mobile technologies ensures that students are prepared to excel in our increasingly digital world.

  1. The “Technology Triangle” - comprising Kitchener, Waterloo, and Cambridge – nurtures a thriving technology scene. Many startups and innovation hubs have sprung up, earning the region the nickname “Silicon Valley of the North.”
  2. Kitchener hosts Canada’s largest Oktoberfest, reflecting its German heritage. Dating back to 1969, it has grown into a nine-day festival attracting over 700,000 attendees.
  3. Though separate cities, Kitchener and neighboring Waterloo are often jointly referred to as “Kitchener–Waterloo” or K-W. Their proximity and shared history as 19th-century German settlements fostered intertwined identities.
administrative:
1. Application dossier

Students will receive the study abroad application by email after official nomination.

The university will most likely ask for:

  • Copy of passport
  • A cover letter in English
  • Your transcripts in English
  • A letter of nomination (to be provided by the IAFF department)
  • A document proving you did your vaccines
  • A 3x4 cm identity photo
  • Medical insurance in English


2. Visa

(See the Americas Teams channel for information or deadline to follow)

  • Many students who study in Canada for less than six months do not require a Study Permit.
  • Visa-exempt foreign nationals who fly to or transit through Canada will need an Electronic Travel Authorization (eTA). Detailed information is available on the Canadian Embassy’s website
  • As a student for 1 year, you need to apply ONLINE for a Study Permit which will automatically issue an electronic travel authorization.
  • Study permit info: here
  • Application guide: here
  • Document Checklist here


Forms which need to be completed, signed, and dated:

  • Application for Study Permit made Outside of Canada (IMM 1294)
  • Family Information (IMM 5707)
  • Authority to Release Personal Information to a Designated Individual (IMM 5475) if applicable
  • Statutory Declaration of Common-Law Union (IMM 5409) if applicable
  • Proof of payment (biometric and Study Permit)
  • Photocopy of passport showing the passport number, issuance and expiry dates, photo, name, date and place of birth
  • Two photos meeting visa application photograph specifications
  • Letter of acceptance from your Canadian school
  • Provincial attestation letter / Territorial Attestation Letter
  • Proof of financial support
  • Medical exam
  • Photocopy of marriage license/certificate if applicable
  • Any additional documents required by the responsible visa office


3. Insurance

  • You must also take out international insurance covering medical and hospital costs on site, as well as repatriation.
  • Contact the university to check if they offer insurance within their university.
